description: Central Province - The Order made under Sections 277(1)(i), 277(1B) (b) of the amended Municipal Council Ordinance (Chapter 252) to be read with Sec. 2 of the Provincial Council (Consequential Provisions) Act, No. 12 of 1989, remove Mr. D. N. Aluvihare, Mayor of the Municipal Council Matale from Office with effect from 02.12.2020
categorisation: This gazette content concerns the removal of a municipal mayor from office following a judicial/administrative inquiry into misconduct allegations. It involves law enforcement and judicial processes (Commission of Inquiry, evidence consideration, findings of misdeeds) and results in an official removal order issued by the Provincial Governor under specific legal ordinances. This falls under judicial/law enforcement matters rather than standard government personnel changes.
